progression.stopsAfter: Explain immediate pressure change, gas-count response and opposite expansion application. Equal-gas/inert-gas extension deferred and unclaimed.
progression.nextLesson: C4B catalyst delivery part, plus required separate pressure edge-case support before complete C4A coverage.

teaching.task: Why does compression produce more ammonia?
teaching.causalExplanation: Same gas in less space gives more wall impacts; atom-conserving ammonia formation reduces gas count and partly offsets the imposed pressure rise.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Plain meaning before terms, current physical change before labels; separate prompt-only and feedback takes.
teaching.openingDecision: Concrete comparison, explained before independent new-case thinking.
teaching.understandingCheck: Complete supplied conditions and both demands, question-only narration followed by 15-second hold; separate answer narration.
teaching.curriculumScope: Focused unequal-gas-count compression/expansion cut. Equal-gas-total and inert-gas-at-fixed-volume extension remains required later support, not covered here.
teaching.notes: Separate 20-second quiet optional book notes; source and practical coverage remain pending.
